# Frictionborn Motion

> Frictionborn Motion is a verified motion and WebGL component registry for React 19 and Next.js 16, engineered for zero visual slop, static server rendering, and zero-idle resource usage.

Docs: https://frictionborn.com/docs
Registry: https://frictionborn.com/r

## Core Principles
- **Server Output is Static**: No opacity: 0 or transforms in server HTML. Hidden-before-reveal CSS only under [data-motion="ok"].
- **Single Frame Loop**: Animated items share one loop (useFrame from @frictionborn/runtime). Direct requestAnimationFrame is forbidden.
- **Strict WebGL Leases**: At most 4 live WebGL contexts per page on a fine pointer, 2 on coarse. WebGL code loads only when leased.
- **Reduced Motion is Architectural**: Mode is declared and verified (static, still-frame, opacity-only, or off).

## Components

| Item | Slot | Summary | Spec Sheet |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [ambient-hero](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/ambient-hero) | `composition` | Hero composition: ambient canvas (mesh/noise/particles) + TextReveal + MagneticButton (DOM+WebGL, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> T2) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/ambient-hero.md) |
| [distortion-image](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/distortion-image) | `media` | media: WebGL2 hover-displacement image overlay (webgl, client-only, reduced motion -> static image, mobile -> plain image / 0 contexts) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/distortion-image.md) |
| [magnetic-button](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/magnetic-button) | `cta` | cta: Magnetic spring wrapper for buttons and links with fine-pointer gating (dom, server-safe, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> 0 listeners) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/magnetic-button.md) |
| [marquee](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/marquee) | `strip` | strip: Infinite marquee with inert duplicate, hover/focus pause, and pause button (dom, server-safe, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> animates) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/marquee.md) |
| [mesh-gradient](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/mesh-gradient) | `background` | background: multi-color organic mesh gradient via WebGL2 (webgl2, client-only, reduced motion -> static poster, DPR <= 1.5 on mobile/Tier 2) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/mesh-gradient.md) |
| [noise-field](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/noise-field) | `background` | background: WebGL2 domain-warped noise hero background (webgl2, client-only, reduced motion -> static poster, mobile -> tier 2 / tier 1 poster) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/noise-field.md) |
| [particle-field](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/particle-field) | `background` | background: WebGL2 vertex-shader particle drift with pointer repel (webgl2, client-only, reduced motion -> poster, mobile -> tier 2 / tier 1 poster) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/particle-field.md) |
| [scroll-reveal](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/scroll-reveal) | `media` | media: Scroll-driven entrance (CSS view() timeline, IntersectionObserver fallback) (dom, server-safe, reduced motion -> static, low-end mobile -> 12px) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/scroll-reveal.md) |
| [scroll-showcase](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/scroll-showcase) | `composition` | Scroll composition: StickyScrollStory + ScrollReveal + optional Marquee; all copy comes from props (DOM, reduced motion -> static/opacity, mobile -> stacked) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/scroll-showcase.md) |
| [smooth-scroll](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/smooth-scroll) | `page-provider` | page-provider: Lenis provider stepped strictly via useFrame with autoRaf false (dom, server-safe, singleton, reduced motion -> off, mobile -> off) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/smooth-scroll.md) |
| [sticky-scroll-story](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/sticky-scroll-story) | `scroll-section` | scroll-section: Sticky media column with scrolling steps (dom, server-safe, CLS <= 0.01, reduced motion -> opacity-only (instant swap), mobile -> stacked) | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/sticky-scroll-story.md) |
| [text-reveal](https://frictionborn.com/docs/items/text-reveal) | `headline` | headline: word/line/char text reveal (dom, server-safe); SSR text stays static; reduced motion -> static; low-end mobile -> 40 ms stagger | [Spec Sheet](agents/skill/frictionborn/references/items/text-reveal.md) |

## Setup
1. Register the namespace once, in `components.json` (use the registry URL published with the release):
```json
{ "registries": { "@frictionborn": "<registry-base-url>/r/{name}.json" } }
```
2. Install an item (the shadcn CLI also installs the registry items it depends on, and `@frictionborn/runtime`):
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @frictionborn/<component-name>
```
3. Items whose sheet lists a "Client Reveal Gate" need one line: Next.js renders `<MotionReadyScript />` in `<head>` of the root layout; Vite / SPA calls `initMotionReady()` before the first render. Both come from `@frictionborn/runtime`.

## Runtime Usage
```tsx
import { MotionReadyScript, initMotionReady, useFrame, useReducedMotion } from "@frictionborn/runtime";
```
